description: This file defines the ItemDisplayController class, which manages display and sorting of items in a collection, including filtering, sorting, and handling collection changes.

classes.name: ItemDisplayController
classes.description: A controller class for managing display, sorting, and filtering of items within a collection based on various options and collection changes.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns the current sorted list of display items.

methods.name: setDisplayOptions
methods.description: Updates display options and triggers re-sorting of items.

methods.name: onCollectionChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the collection, filtering and sorting items accordingly.

methods.name: filterThenSortElements
methods.description: Filters and sorts a list of items based on current options and collection state.

methods.name: resortItems
methods.description: Sorts the items array and updates their positions in the sort map.
